newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures rally sharply, end up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures rally sharply, end up.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures rallied sharply in the afternoon and ended higher in brisk trading.
Traders said a positive bias heading into multiple expirations at the end of this week and characteristic resilience fueled the market's move.
September Standard and Poor's 500 futures added to morning gains and shot to a fresh record high at 911.20 in afternoon trade, passing the former record set Tuesday at 908.50.
Traders noted that steep gains in most indices came amid a quiet, flat tone in U.S. debt markets.
"This was not an interest rate-driven market, this was an expiration phenonmenon," said Jack Bouroudjian, equity futures and options vice president at Credit Agricole.
"The market was obviously very strong today going into tomorrow's expiration," he said.
June S&P 500 futures stopped trading Thursday and will settle early Friday. Individual equity options and S&P 100 and S&P 500 index options all expire at week's end.
Traders said June/September spread activity was brisk Thursday.

The firm tone began early after a narrower-than-expected U.S. trade gap for April and a rise in new jobless claims. September S&P 500 futures briefly cut gains after a strong Philadelphia Fed index weighed on bonds.
But stock index futures soon shook off the dim bond tone and headed higher, triggering waves of buy stops just below the old high of 908.50.

The Philadelphia Fed's business activity index rose to 25.2 in June from 1.6 in May, compared with a forecast for 7.3 in June. The U.S. trade gap widened to $8.36 billion from a revised $7.76 billion gap in March.
The latest weekly jobless claims rose to 347,000 in the June 14 week from 339,000 in the prior week.

At the close, September S&P 500s were up 8.20 points at 907.50, Nasdaq 100s were 10.75 higher at 997.00, Russell 2000s were up 3.55 points to 400.85, KCBT Value Line futures were up 5.20 points to 799.15, Nikkei 225 index futures rose 90.0 to 20,605.0 and Midcap 400s rose 0.80 point to 293.90.
